question: How are the world-guardians allocated in relation to three-plot and intermediate two-share divisions?
premises: World-guardians are assigned to three-plot divisions.
Some guardians are situated in intermediate positions.
Those intermediate guardians receive two shares.
inference: The world-guardians occupy three-plot divisions, while intermediate ones are allotted two shares.
plain_english: The world-guardians should occupy three plots, and those situated between should have two shares.
